summary: AccountCode functionality manages account codes for agencies, providing methods to add, update, delete, and retrieve account code records. The core logic is implemented via the AccountCodeRecord and AccountCodes classes, which interact with the database through stored procedures and parameterized queries.
purpose: To support agency-level account code management, including CRUD operations on account codes, ensuring data integrity and providing formatted data for UI binding.

workflows.name: Add Account Code
steps: Add parameters (AgencyID, AccountCode, Code, Description, SortOrder).

workflows.name: Retrieve Account Codes
steps: For each record: instantiate AccountCodeRecord, populate fields, add to list.

business_rules: AccountCode, Code, and Description must not be blank to be valid.
SortOrder is required for sorting account codes.
validations: IsValid checks for non-blank AccountCode, Code, Description; adds error messages and prevents operation if invalid.
conditions: Add/Update/Delete operations only proceed when ID is non-zero and validations pass.
system_behavior: Uses parameterized stored procedures for all DB operations.
Supports static method to retrieve single records for UI binding.
exceptions: Validation failures return error messages and prevent DB operation.
If data reader is null, retrieval is skipped.
content_gaps: No details about UI usage beyond GetSingleEntryToBind.
No explicit error handling for DB failures.
No information on usage context, permissions, or user roles.
